key_expressions: Were you able to follow the notes?,
Are you ready for the next class?,

A: How was the class today?
There were a few parts that felt a bit difficult for me.
I think I need to review it again while organizing my notes.
B: It was better than I expected!
The tricky parts made more sense when the professor gave examples.
If we review it together, I think we can figure it out quickly.

A: Today's lesson felt a bit more complicated than last week's.
Especially the formulas—they didn’t click right away.
I should probably solve more practice problems at home.
B: Yeah, there were suddenly a lot more formulas.
Doing practice problems really helps you get the hang of it.
If you want, I can show you the ones I solved.

A: I feel like the professor spoke a bit fast today.
It was hard to keep up at some points.
Thankfully, I recorded the lecture so I can listen again.
B: Right? Today was especially fast!
I missed a few sentences too.
If you have a recording, replaying it will totally help.

A: The lecture materials were more useful than I expected.
They're well organized, so they’re easy to follow.
I think I'll print them and carry them around.
B: Yeah, the materials are really well made.
They helped me a lot when taking notes.
If you print them, it’ll be much easier to keep up in class.

A: Wasn't today's group discussion pretty fun?
Everyone seemed to have a lot of opinions.
Thanks to that, the concepts became much clearer for me.
B: Yeah! Everyone was really active today.
Talking things out makes it way easier to understand.
I wish we had more discussion-based classes.

A: Did you catch the assignment explanation clearly today?
I got a little confused at the last part.
It might help if we check it together.
B: I missed a bit at the end too.
But they said a summary will be uploaded soon.
Once we look at it together, I think it’ll be clear.

A: The atmosphere in class felt really lively today.
There were lots of questions and reactions, right?
Because of that, it was easier to focus.
B: Yeah! Everyone was full of energy.
Even the professor seemed to be in a good mood.
With this kind of atmosphere, class feels much easier.

A: The professor said today's topic will be on the exam, right?
So I listened more carefully than usual.
I also took notes more seriously than I usually do.
B: Yes, it’s definitely on the exam!
I was nervous and focused too.
If your notes are good, you’ve already done half the work.

A: Did you notice the slide colors changed?
The readability got much better.
The content stood out more for me today.
B: Yeah, the new colors look way better!
It helped me focus more too.
It feels like the quality of the lecture improved a lot.

A: I actually feel a bit more confident after today's class.
I think I'm finally starting to understand the flow.
I might be able to follow the next class better.
B: Oh, hearing that motivates me too!
Once you get the flow, everything becomes easier.
Let’s do our best in the next class as well!
